title: Use a prompt as a runnable
summary: Prompt templates can also be invoked as runnable steps. The result is a prompt value that can be converted to plain text for inspection.
introduction: Prompt templates can also be invoked as runnable steps. The result is a prompt value that can be converted to plain text for inspection. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain use a prompt as a runnable
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Prompt templates can also be invoked as runnable steps. The result is a prompt value that can be converted to plain text for inspection.

blocks.code:
from langchain_core.prompts import PromptTemplate
prompt = PromptTemplate.from_template("Name one fact about {topic}.")
value = prompt.invoke({"topic": "seeds"})
print(value.to_string())
blocks.title: Use a prompt as a runnable

blocks.text: The output is Name one fact about seeds. invoke receives the variable dictionary. to_string exposes the prepared prompt for review.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.text: Prepared prompt text is not an answer from a model.
